domain_hypothesis.reasoning: The dataset contains standard employee demographical, professional, and sentiment attributes like Attrition, MonthlyIncome, OverTime, JobSatisfaction, and various tenure metrics which perfectly match HR/people analytics schemas.

kpi_specs.name: Overall Attrition Rate
kpi_specs.description: The percentage of employees who have left the organization, serving as a high-level health metric for overall employee retention.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition = 'Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS attrition_rate FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: A single KPI card represents the company-wide attrition benchmark against which all segments are compared.

kpi_specs.name: Attrition Rate by Department
kpi_specs.description: Compares attrition percentages across different departments to pinpoint specific areas with retention challenges.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT Department, COUNT(*) AS total_employees, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition = 'Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS attrition_rate FROM data GROUP BY Department ORDER BY attrition_rate DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: A bar chart highlights which departments have disproportionately higher rates of employee turnover.

kpi_specs.name: Average Monthly Income by Job Role
kpi_specs.description: Analyzes internal compensation equity and competitiveness by mapping average monthly income across job roles.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT JobRole, ROUND(AVG(MonthlyIncome), 2) AS avg_monthly_income FROM data GROUP BY JobRole ORDER BY avg_monthly_income DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: A bar chart visually contrasts salary levels across the various categorical roles in the organization.

kpi_specs.name: Income Progression by Working Years
kpi_specs.description: Tracks how monthly income scales with total working years to understand career-progression and tenure-based compensation trends.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT TotalWorkingYears, ROUND(AVG(MonthlyIncome), 2) AS avg_monthly_income FROM data GROUP BY TotalWorkingYears ORDER BY TotalWorkingYears ASC
kpi_specs.reasoning: Total working years acts as a continuous time-like or sequential axis, making a line chart ideal for displaying progression trends.

kpi_specs.name: Role-Level Retention Risk Matrix
kpi_specs.description: A comprehensive table that correlates average job satisfaction, overtime prevalence, average promotion intervals, and actual attrition rate by job role to detect risk factors.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT JobRole, COUNT(*) AS total_employees, ROUND(AVG(JobSatisfaction), 2) AS avg_job_satisfaction, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN OverTime = 'Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS overtime_rate, ROUND(AVG(YearsSinceLastPromotion), 2) AS avg_years_since_promotion, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition = 'Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS attrition_rate FROM data GROUP BY JobRole ORDER BY attrition_rate DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: A detailed table enables HR teams to view multiple concurrent metrics (satisfaction, overtime, and promotion delays) alongside attrition rate to diagnose underlying issues.
